method: Isolated source/service probes with in-memory Prisma doubles; synthetic local asset; no live DB or browser verification.

findings.evidence: User-controlled displayName =1+1 remains an unescaped formula prefix in exported CSV.
ACTIVE -> ARCHIVED -> DRAFT clears publishedAt; updateProfile then accepts a different slug. Old printed URL is no longer reserved by this profile.
A stale full-form payload overwrites editor A jobTitle without a version conflict. Service calls use an in-memory database double.
Two concurrent calls whose pre-insert duplicate reads both miss are both accepted; controlled interleaving with in-memory Prisma doubles, not a database load test.
Synthetic image served anonymously without checking profile/company status or showPhoto.
Company primaryColor permits white. Admin primary buttons hard-code white text; public buttons choose a contrasting foreground, but public company-name text also uses brand color on a white surface.
